mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the single-pending-per-customer fact lets Alloy build two pending applications owned by the same customer; the injection forces exactly that, which FR_005_OnePendingPerCustomer forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnePendingViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | (a1.customer = a2.customer) and (a1.status = PendingReview) and (a2.status = PendingReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the staff-only-decider fact removes the role check on Decision.decidedBy; the injection forces a Decision whose decider has Customer role, which FR_015 says is impossible.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_StaffOnlyViolation { some d: Decision | d.decidedBy.role = Customer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission-matrix definition makes Allowed unconstrained; the injection forces Customer->PostDecision into the matrix, directly violating LeastPrivilege and FR-015's denial clause.

Clearing the decision-event/status binding lets pending applications acquire decision events; the injection forces a pending application carrying an ApprovedEvent, which AppendOnly forbids and which AuditCompleteness's pending/decided partitioning rejects.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some a: LoanApplication, e: ApplicationEvent | (a.status = PendingReview) and (e.application = a) and (e.eventType = ApprovedEvent) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the at-most-one-decision constraint allows two Decision atoms to point at the same application; the injection forces that pair, which FR-011, FR-012 and ConcurrencySafety all rule out.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoDecisionsViolation { some disj d1, d2: Decision | d1.application = d2.application }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the customer-role fact lets a LoanApplication be owned by a bank_staff user; the injection forces such an instance, breaking OwnershipExclusivity's role typing and FR-001/FR-013's customer-only origination.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some a: LoanApplication | a.customer.role = BankStaff }
